<a id="page-state"></a>
# State and logic

<a id="state-when-to-use"></a>
## When to use

Variables and where they live, computed and function variables, expressions and every binding path with the value
it expects, conditions, the formula functions (grouped: text, numbers, money, lists, objects, dates, colours), the
actions that change state, and sandboxed scripts.

<a id="state-minimal-example"></a>
## Minimal example

A counter: a variable, two buttons that change it, and a text and a colour bound to it.

```json
{
  "schema": 3,
  "roots": ["counter"],
  "nodes": {
    "counter": {
      "type": "canvas",
      "slots": {"body": "col"},
      "layout": {"width": 390, "height": 400},
      "decoration": {"fills": [{"color": "#FFFFFFFF"}]}
    },
    "col": {
      "type": "column",
      "children": ["label", "total", "add"],
      "layout": {"width": {"fill": 390}, "height": {"fill": 400}, "padding": 24},
      "props": {"spacing": 12, "mainAxisAlignment": "center"}
    },
    "label": {
      "type": "text",
      "layout": {"width": {"hug": 120}, "height": {"hug": 24}},
      "props": {"text": "Clicked ${count} times", "style": {"fontSize": 18, "color": "#FF111827"}}
    },
    "total": {
      "type": "text",
      "layout": {"width": {"hug": 120}, "height": {"hug": 20}},
      "props": {"text": "", "style": {"fontSize": 14, "color": "#FF6B7280"}},
      "bind": {"props.text": "${= 'Total: ' + money(count * price, '$')}"}
    },
    "add": {
      "type": "box",
      "layout": {"width": 160, "height": 44},
      "decoration": {"fills": [{"color": "#FF2563EB"}], "radius": 8},
      "actions": [
        {
          "trigger": {"type": "click"},
          "actions": [{"type": "setVariable", "variable": "count", "op": "add", "value": "1"}]
        }
      ]
    }
  },
  "variables": {
    "counter": [{"name": "count", "type": "integer", "value": 0}, {"name": "price", "type": "decimal", "value": 2.5}]
  }
}
```

<a id="state-reference"></a>
## Reference

<a id="state-variables"></a>
### Variables

Declare them in the document's `variables`, under a canvas id (that canvas only) or under `"page_variables"` (every
canvas of the document, kept while the user moves between them). A site's `site.json` adds project variables, read
by bare name in every page and component. A variable's keys:

| Key | Example | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | `"v1"` |  |
| `name` | `"count"` | Unique in its scope; what expressions read (`${name}`). |
| `type` | `"integer"` |  |
| `value` | `3` | The default value, as `type` holds it (see `VariableType.coerce`); null when unset. |
| `formula` | `"a + 1"` | The expression (what goes in `${= ...}`) that computes the value of a computed variable; empty for a plain one. A computed variable is read-only: it changes when what its formula reads changes. |
| `parameters` | `["a"]` | A computed variable with parameters is a function: formulas call it by name (`clamp01(x)`), and its `formula` reads the arguments by these names. |
| `options` | `["a"]` | The options of a `VariableType.choice` variable. |
| `persist` | `true` | Whether the app keeps the value on the device: it starts from the value it had last time (not `value`) and every change is saved. A draft, a list the user builds up. A computed variable can't persist (`persists`). |

Types:

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `integer` | A whole number (`int`). |
| `text` | Text (`String`). |
| `decimal` | A number with decimals (`double`). |
| `boolean` | `true` or `false`. |
| `color` | A color, `#AARRGGBB`. |
| `list` | A JSON list. |
| `map` | A JSON object. |
| `image` | An image URL. |
| `choice` | One of `Variable.options`, stored as the option's value. |

<a id="state-expressions"></a>
### Expressions

`${name}` or `${path}` reads a value: `${count}`, `${user.name}`, `${items[0].price}`, `${pal[item.kind]}`.
`${= formula}` computes one: arithmetic (`+ - * / %`), comparisons (`== != < <= > >=`), `&&`, `||`, `!`,
`cond ? a : b`, literals (`'text'`, `3.5`, `true`, `null`, lists `[1, 2]`), and lambdas for list functions
(`x => x.price`). A text that is exactly one expression gives its value with its type; inside other text a number is
printed without trailing zeros. Names an expression may start with, besides the variables: `data`, `route`, `storage`, `screen`, `theme`, `item`, `index`, `parent`, `result`, `loop`, `auth`, `drag`, `perf`, `track`, `dismiss`, `pan`, `transform`, `flip`, `tilt`, `view`, `sticky`, `script`, `speech`, `pageOffset`, `form`. The
names a node gives the nodes inside it are read there only: `item`, `index`, `parent` in a list's item; `pageOffset`
in a `pageView`'s page (its distance from the current page, for parallax; not the page's scroll); `form` inside a
`form`; `track`, `sticky`, `view` and the like inside their node. A page's or a list's scroll position is its `scroll`
reaction's `${result.offset}` (and `index`, `fraction`), stored in a variable that anything may bind.

<a id="state-binding-paths"></a>
### Binding paths

What each path of `bind` expects. A formula gives the value as the field is written in JSON: a number, `true` /
`false`, a name for an enum, a list or an object for the fields written that way. A value of another shape is not
read and the field keeps its value. Values are read loosely: `"12"` is a number, `1` and `"true"` are true.

| Path | Type | A formula gives |
|---|---|---|
| `visible` | `bool` | `true` or `false` |
| `opacity` | `double` | a number |
| `selected` | `bool` | `true` or `false` |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `true` or `false` |
| `data` | `List` | a list |
| `layout.width` | `AxisSize` | a number (fixed) or {"fill"\|"flexible"\|"hug"\|"fixed": number} |
| `layout.height` | `AxisSize` | a number (fixed) or {"fill"\|"flexible"\|"hug"\|"fixed": number} |
| `layout.constraints` | `BoxConstraints` | {"minWidth", "maxWidth", "minHeight", "maxHeight"} (each optional, numbers >= 0) |
| `layout.margin` | `EdgeInsets` | a number (all sides) or [left, top, right, bottom] |
| `layout.padding` | `EdgeInsets` | a number (all sides) or [left, top, right, bottom] |
| `layout.aspectRatio` | `double` | a number |
| `layout.flex` | `int` | a whole number |
| `layout.squeezable` | `bool` | `true` or `false` |
| `layout.x` | `AxisPosition` | a number (distance from the start) or {"start": d}, {"end": d}, {"start": a, "end": b}, {"align": -1..1}, {"relative": d} |
| `layout.y` | `AxisPosition` | a number (distance from the start) or {"start": d}, {"end": d}, {"start": a, "end": b}, {"align": -1..1}, {"relative": d} |
| `layout.align` | `Alignment` | [x, y] from -1 to 1, or a name: topLeft, topCenter, topRight, centerLeft, center, centerRight, bottomLeft, bottomCenter, bottomRight |
| `layout.order` | `int` | a whole number |
| `layout.basis` | `double` | a number |
| `layout.columnSpan` | `int` | a whole number |
| `layout.rowSpan` | `int` | a whole number |
| `layout.columnStart` | `int` | a whole number |
| `layout.rowStart` | `int` | a whole number |
| `decoration.fills` | `List<Paint>` | a list of Paint objects |
| `decoration.strokes` | `List<Paint>` | a list of Paint objects |
| `decoration.strokeWidth` | `double` | a number |
| `decoration.strokeAlign` | `StrokeAlign` | one of its names ([StrokeAlign](values.md#enum-StrokeAlign)) |
| `decoration.strokeSides` | `StrokeSides` | one of its names ([StrokeSides](values.md#enum-StrokeSides)) |
| `decoration.strokeCap` | `StrokeCap` | one of its names ([StrokeCap](values.md#enum-StrokeCap)) |
| `decoration.dashPattern` | `List<double>` | a list of double objects |
| `decoration.radius` | `BorderRadius` | a number (every corner), [x, y] (every corner elliptical) or [topLeft, topRight, bottomRight, bottomLeft] (each a number or [x, y]) |
| `decoration.effects` | `List<Effect>` | a list of Effect objects |
| `decoration.clip` | `Clip` | one of its names ([Clip](values.md#enum-Clip)) |
| `decoration.blendMode` | `BlendMode` | one of its names ([BlendMode](values.md#enum-BlendMode)) |
| `decoration.foregroundFills` | `List<Paint>` | a list of Paint objects |
| `decoration.shape` | `DecorationShape` | one of its names ([DecorationShape](values.md#enum-DecorationShape)) |

`props.<prop>` takes what the prop's type is written as: `"${= open ? 'vertical' : 'horizontal'}"` for
`props.direction`, a TextStyle object or a theme style's name for `props.style`. Every bindable field:

- `layout.<field>`: `width`, `height`, `constraints`, `margin`, `padding`, `aspectRatio`, `flex`, `squeezable`, `x`, `y`, `align`, `order`, `basis`, `columnSpan`, `rowSpan`, `columnStart`, `rowStart`, and `widthFactor`, `heightFactor`.
- `decoration.<field>`: `fills`, `strokes`, `strokeWidth`, `strokeAlign`, `strokeSides`, `strokeCap`, `dashPattern`, `radius`, `effects`, `clip`, `blendMode`, `foregroundFills`, `shape`. Inside `fills`, `strokes`, `foregroundFills` and `effects`, select an item by `[index]`, by its `id`, or every item by `*`, then a field of [Paint](decoration.md#type-Paint) or [Effect](decoration.md#type-Effect) (`decoration.fills[0].color`, `decoration.effects.*.color`, `.offset.dx`).
- `props.<prop>`: any prop of the node's type, and `props.<prop>.<field>` for a field of a model prop.
- `<behavior>` and `<behavior>.<field>`: [`motion`](animation.md#behavior-motion), [`animations`](animation.md#behavior-animations), [`transitions`](animation.md#behavior-transitions), [`shimmer`](animation.md#behavior-shimmer), [`inkWell`](interaction.md#behavior-inkWell), [`states`](interaction.md#behavior-states), [`tooltip`](interaction.md#behavior-tooltip), [`ignorePointer`](interaction.md#behavior-ignorePointer), [`floating`](layout.md#behavior-floating), [`hero`](animation.md#behavior-hero), [`draggable`](interaction.md#behavior-draggable), [`dropTarget`](interaction.md#behavior-dropTarget), [`track`](interaction.md#behavior-track), [`dismissible`](interaction.md#behavior-dismissible), [`pan`](interaction.md#behavior-pan), [`reorderHandle`](lists.md#behavior-reorderHandle), [`reveal`](animation.md#behavior-reveal), [`typewriter`](animation.md#behavior-typewriter), [`particles`](animation.md#behavior-particles), [`textDirection`](theme.md#behavior-textDirection), [`defaultTextStyle`](theme.md#behavior-defaultTextStyle), [`flip`](animation.md#behavior-flip), [`tilt`](animation.md#behavior-tilt), [`transformGesture`](interaction.md#behavior-transformGesture), [`sticky`](layout.md#behavior-sticky), [`viewProgress`](animation.md#behavior-viewProgress), [`measure`](layout.md#behavior-measure), [`customPaint`](decoration.md#behavior-customPaint), [`form`](forms.md#behavior-form), [`radioGroup`](forms.md#behavior-radioGroup).

Named paths:

| Path | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `visible` |  |
| `opacity` |  |
| `selected` | Interaction states driven by data: true puts the node in `WidgetState.selected` / `WidgetState.disabled`, so its state styles (`states.selected`, `states.disabled`) patch it and its descendants, as hover and press do (`"selected": "${= item.id == selectedId}"`). |
| `disabled` |  |
| `data` | The items a repeating widget (list, grid, page view) builds one per. |
| `layout.width` |  |
| `layout.height` |  |
| `layout.flex` |  |
| `layout.margin` |  |
| `layout.padding` |  |
| `layout.x` |  |
| `layout.y` |  |
| `decoration.radius` |  |
| `decoration.strokeWidth` |  |
| `textDirection` |  |

<a id="state-conditions"></a>
### Conditions

An if / else-if / else rule. Its first branch whose test holds and that sets a property gives the property its value; when none does, the property keeps its binding's or its own value. JSON:

```json
{"id": "c1", "name": "Low stock", "branches": [
  {"when": {"left": "${stock}", "op": "lessThan", "right": "5"},
   "set": [{"node": "badge", "path": "visible", "value": true}]},
  {"set": [{"node": "badge", "path": "visible", "value": false}]}]}

```

- Branch: One branch: when `when` holds (always, for an `else`: null), the properties in `sets` take their values.
- Set entry: Sets property `path` (a binding path, DESIGN.md §5.1) of node `node` to `value`: a JSON value, where a string is an expression read like a binding's (`${= qty * 2}`, `#FF0000`, `Hello ${name}`).
- Comparison: `left op right` (the right side only for ops that `ConditionOp.takesRight`).
- Junction: All of `parts` (`and`) or any of them (`or`). Every part is evaluated. JSON: `{"and": [...]}` / `{"or": [...]}`.
- Operand: One side of a `Comparison`: an expression text whose `${...}` are read (`${count}`, `${= a + b}`, `3`, `done`), or, when `raw`, a literal taken as written. Both are then parsed loosely (`3` is a number, `true` a bool, `[1, 2]` a list). JSON: the text, or `{"raw": text}`.

| op | Reads right | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `equalsTo` | yes |  |
| `notEqualsTo` | yes |  |
| `greaterThan` | yes |  |
| `lessThan` | yes |  |
| `greaterThanOrEqualTo` | yes |  |
| `lessThanOrEqualTo` | yes |  |
| `isEmpty` | no | Null, or an empty text, list or map. |
| `isNotEmpty` | no |  |
| `contains` | yes | A list holds the right operand, a text contains it, a map has it as a key. |
| `isOdd` | no |  |
| `isEven` | no |  |
| `isNull` | no | Null, or the text `null`. |
| `isTrue` | no |  |
| `isFalse` | no |  |

<a id="state-scripts"></a>
### Scripts

A document's sandboxed JavaScript (`scripts`), run by `runScript` or called from a formula (`script.name(...)`).

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | String | `""` |  |  |
| `name` | String | `""` |  | A JavaScript identifier: script.<name>(...). |
| `description` | String | `""` |  |  |
| `params` | Object | unset |  | [{"name", "description", "defaultValue"}]. |
| `source` | String | `""` |  | JavaScript. |
| `version` | int | `1` |  | Goes up each time the script is saved. |
| `capabilities` | List<String> | `[]` |  | What it may do: variables.read, variables.write, nodes.read, navigation, api, cloud, actions, clock. |
| `timeoutMs` | int | `1000` | ≥ 1 |  |
| `memoryLimitMb` | int | `32` | ≥ 1 | Enforced on devices; on the web only `timeoutMs` applies. |
| `pageId` | String | unset |  | Null: a project script. |
| `tests` | Object | unset |  | Sample runs: [{"name", "args", "vars", "nodes", "expect", "expectError"}]. |

<a id="state-formula-functions"></a>
### Formula functions

The functions a formula (`${= ...}`) can call, from the SDK's formula engine, grouped.

<a id="state-text"></a>
#### Text

| Function | Signature | Example |
|---|---|---|
| <a id="fn-left"></a>`left` | `left(text, count)` | `left("MX4821", 2) → MX` |
| <a id="fn-right"></a>`right` | `right(text, count)` | `right("1FUJGLDR5MX4821", 6) → MX4821` |
| <a id="fn-upper"></a>`upper` | `upper(text)` | `upper("hi") → HI` |
| <a id="fn-lower"></a>`lower` | `lower(text)` | `lower("Hi") → hi` |
| <a id="fn-trim"></a>`trim` | `trim(text)` | `trim("  hi ") → hi` |
| <a id="fn-contains"></a>`contains` | `contains(text or list, value)` | `contains(lower(title), lower(search)) → true` |
| <a id="fn-startsWith"></a>`startsWith` | `startsWith(text, prefix)` | `startsWith("Buy milk", "Buy") → true` |
| <a id="fn-endsWith"></a>`endsWith` | `endsWith(text, suffix)` | `endsWith("photo.png", ".png") → true` |
| <a id="fn-padLeft"></a>`padLeft` | `padLeft(value, width, char)` | `padLeft(4, 2) → 04 (numbers pad with 0, text with spaces)` |
| `padLeft` | `padLeft(text, width, char?)` | `padLeft(42, 5, "0") → 00042` |
| <a id="fn-padRight"></a>`padRight` | `padRight(value, width, char)` | `padRight("A", 3, ".") → A..` |
| `padRight` | `padRight(text, width, char?)` | `padRight("ab", 4, ".") → ab..` |
| <a id="fn-substring"></a>`substring` | `substring(text, start, end)` | `substring("Vinyl", 0, 3) → Vin` |
| `substring` | `substring(text, start, end?)` | `substring("EX-102", 3) → 102` |
| <a id="fn-replace"></a>`replace` | `replace(text, from, to)` | `replace("a-b-c", "-", " ") → a b c` |
| `replace` | `replace(text, from, to)` | `replace("1,402", ",", "") → 1402` |
| <a id="fn-regexReplace"></a>`regexReplace` | `regexReplace(text, pattern, to)` | `regexReplace("WILLOW PHARMACY 044", " [0-9]+$", "") → WILLOW PHARMACY; \$1 in to inserts a group` |
| <a id="fn-titleCase"></a>`titleCase` | `titleCase(text)` | `titleCase("SQ *KESTREL FLOWERS") → Sq *Kestrel Flowers` |
| <a id="fn-split"></a>`split` | `split(text, separator)` | `split("rock, jazz", ", ") → [rock, jazz]` |
| `split` | `split(text, separator?)` | `split("2481") → [2, 4, 8, 1]` |
| <a id="fn-matches"></a>`matches` | `matches(text, pattern)` | `matches(code, "^\d{4}$") → true` |
| <a id="fn-slug"></a>`slug` | `slug(text)` | `slug("Kind of Blue!") → kind-of-blue` |
| <a id="fn-charCode"></a>`charCode` | `charCode(text, index)` | `charCode("MX", 1) → 88` |
| <a id="fn-fromCharCode"></a>`fromCharCode` | `fromCharCode(code, …) or fromCharCode(list)` | `fromCharCode(65 + seat) → B` |
| <a id="fn-codeUnits"></a>`codeUnits` | `codeUnits(text)` | `sum(codeUnits(tag)) % 8 → a stable color index for tag` |
| <a id="fn-join"></a>`join` | `join(list, separator, field or item => value)` | `join(tags, " · ")` |
| <a id="fn-pad"></a>`pad` | `pad(value, width, fill)` | `pad(5, 2) → 05` |
| <a id="fn-text"></a>`text` | `text(value)` | `text(42) → "42"` |
| <a id="fn-runs"></a>`runs` | `runs(list, item => condition)` | `runs(steps, s => s.h <= 1) → [{first, last, items, count}]` |
| <a id="fn-interpolate"></a>`interpolate` | `interpolate(points, xField, yField, x)` | `interpolate(tides, "t", "v", now())` |
| <a id="fn-textDirection"></a>`textDirection` | `textDirection(locale)` | `textDirection("he_IL") → rtl · textDirection("fr") → ltr` |
| <a id="fn-textDirectionOf"></a>`textDirectionOf` | `textDirectionOf(text)` | `textDirectionOf("שלום") → rtl · textDirectionOf("123") → (empty)` |
| <a id="fn-plural"></a>`plural` | `plural(count, one, many) or plural(count, forms, locale?)` | `plural(2, "photo") → photos · plural(2, {one: "{n} phrase", other: "{n} phrases"}, "en") → 2 phrases` |
| <a id="fn-pluralCategory"></a>`pluralCategory` | `pluralCategory(count, locale?)` | `pluralCategory(3, "ar") → few · pluralCategory(0, "en") → other` |

| Function | Signature | Example |

| <a id="fn-money"></a>`money` | `money(value, symbol, decimals) or money(value, decimals)` | `money(price) → $1,234.50` |

| <a id="fn-parseAmount"></a>`parseAmount` | `parseAmount(text, code)` | `parseAmount("1.234,50", "EUR") → 1234.5` |
| <a id="fn-formatAmount"></a>`formatAmount` | `formatAmount(text, code)` | `formatAmount("12345.6", "USD") → 12,345.6` |

<a id="state-triggers"></a>
### Triggers

Written as `"trigger": {"type": "<trigger>", ...}` in a reaction ([trigger fields](interaction.md#interaction-trigger-fields)).

| Trigger | When it fires |
|---|---|
| <a id="trigger-valueChanged"></a>`valueChanged` | Variable `Trigger.variable` changed while the screen shows. |
| <a id="trigger-actionError"></a>`actionError` | On the current canvas: a failed action chain or cloud subscription. `${result.error}` is `{type, message, action, nodeId}` (no stack or raw service objects). A failure in this reaction reports to the host without recursively firing another actionError reaction. |

<a id="action-setVariable"></a>
### `setVariable` (action): Set variable

Changes variable `variable` (of the screen, or the app): `write`. JSON: `{"type": "setVariable", "variable": "count", "op": "add", "value": "1"}`. A computed variable can't be set. To glide a number to a new value, `AnimateAction` it (`animateTo`).

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `variable` | String | `""` |  | The variable's name; a path into it sets that part. |
| `op` | [WriteOp](values.md#enum-WriteOp) | `"set"` | `set`, `toggle`, `add`, `subtract`, `insert`, `insertAll`, `removeAt`, `remove`, `update` | How the value changes. |
| `value` | String | `""` |  | The value (an expression); not for toggle, removeAt. |
| `index` | String | `""` |  | A list index (an expression). |
| `mapKey` | String | `""` |  | A map key (an expression). |

<a id="action-setValue"></a>
### `setValue` (action): Set value

Sets properties of node `node` at runtime (until the screen goes). A property bound to a variable sets the variable instead.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `node` | String | `""` |  |  |
| `values` | Object | unset |  | The properties set: [{"path", "value" \| "mode"}]. |

<a id="action-setVariant"></a>
### `setVariant` (action): Set variant

Shows variant `variant` of variance node `node`.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `node` | String | `""` |  | A variance node. |
| `variant` | String | `""` |  | The variant's id (an expression). |

<a id="action-callFunction"></a>
### `callFunction` (action): Call function

Calls a function the app registered by `name` with `params` (text values are expressions). Its result is the chain's `${result}`: what the app's code answered (a permission granted, a share completed), which the next actions branch on. A function the app didn't register fails the chain, unless the action is `optional`.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | String | `""` |  | The function the app registered. |
| `params` | Object | unset |  | Its arguments; text values are expressions. |
| `optional` | bool | `false` |  | A function the app didn't register is skipped (${result} is null) instead of failing the chain. |

<a id="action-if"></a>
### `if` (action): If

Runs `then` when `condition` holds, else `orElse`. JSON: `{"type": "if", "condition": {...}, "then": [...], "else": [...]}`.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `condition` | Object | unset |  | A predicate; null never holds. |
| `then` | Object | unset |  | Nested actions: run when it holds. |
| `else` | Object | unset |  | Nested actions: run when it doesn't. |

<a id="action-forEach"></a>
### `forEach` (action): For each

Runs `actions` once per item of list `items` (a path or expression). Every action of a turn reads the item and its index as `${loop.item}` and `${loop.index}`; `${result.item}` and `${result.index}` hold them too, until an action of the turn gives a result of its own.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `items` | String | `""` |  | A list (a path or expression). |
| `actions` | Object | unset |  | Nested actions: run per item (${loop.item}, ${loop.index}). |

<a id="action-delay"></a>
### `delay` (action): Delay

Waits `ms` milliseconds, or `duration` (a formula giving them) when that gives a number.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ms` | int | `500` |  |  |
| `duration` | String | `""` |  | A formula giving milliseconds. |

<a id="action-runScript"></a>
### `runScript` (action): Run script

Runs script `script` (a layout's `scripts`, by id) with `arguments` (by parameter name; expressions: one `${...}` passes its value as is, other text passes as JSON when it is JSON, else as text). Its result is the chain's `${result}` (and goes in `resultVariable` when set). When it fails, `onError` runs with `${result}` `{error: {type, message, line, column}, logs}`; without `onError` a failure stops the chain.

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `script` | String | `""` |  | A script of the layout's scripts. |
| `arguments` | Object | unset |  | By parameter name (expressions). |
| `resultVariable` | String | `""` |  | Gets the result. |
| `onError` | Object | unset |  | Nested actions: run when it fails (${result.error}, ${result.logs}). |

<a id="action-retryFailed"></a>
### `retryFailed` (action): Retry failed actions

In an actionError reaction: runs the failed action chain again.

_No fields._

<a id="state-patterns"></a>
## Patterns

<a id="state-computed-and-function-variables"></a>
### Computed and function variables

A variable with a `formula` (what goes in `${= ...}`) is read-only and follows what it reads; with `parameters` it
is a function any formula calls by name. Declare them in `page_variables` to share them with every canvas of the
document:

```json
"variables": {"page_variables": [
  {"name": "query", "type": "text", "value": ""},
  {"name": "dishes", "type": "list", "value": [{"name": "Lamb", "vegan": false}, {"name": "Squash", "vegan": true}]},
  {"name": "shown", "type": "list", "formula": "filter(dishes, d => contains(lower(d.name), lower(query)))"},
  {"name": "shownCount", "type": "integer", "formula": "length(shown)"},
  {"name": "usd", "type": "text", "parameters": ["n"], "formula": "'$' + round(n)"}
]}
```

`${shown}` feeds a list, `${shownCount}` a label, `${= usd(price * 12)}` any text: write a filter or a rule once,
not in every binding. A function variable's name must not be a formula function's (the built-in one wins).

<a id="state-a-streak-and-other-counts-from-data"></a>
### A streak and other counts from data

Derive, do not store: a computed variable over the records. Habits done today: `count(habits, h => h.done)`.
Totals: `sum(map(cart, i => i.price * i.qty))`. Dates: `formatDate(today(), 'EEE d')`, `addDays(today(), -i)`,
`weekday(date)` (Monday is 1). Function variables may call each other. A streak (checked days in a row ending at
day `end` of a list of booleans): the days up to `end`, reversed, and the index of the first unchecked one.

```json
"variables": {"page_variables": [
  {"name": "todayIdx", "type": "integer", "formula": "weekday(today()) - 1"},
  {"name": "gapAt", "type": "integer", "parameters": ["days", "end"], "formula": "findIndex(reverse(take(days, end + 1)), d => !d)"},
  {"name": "streak", "type": "integer", "parameters": ["days", "end"], "formula": "gapAt(days, end) < 0 ? end + 1 : gapAt(days, end)"}
]}
```

`${= streak(item.days, todayIdx)}` in a habit's row; `${= streak(item.days, todayIdx - 1)}` when today is not
checked yet. For anything with a real loop, a script.

<a id="state-changing-state-from-a-reaction"></a>
### Changing state from a reaction

`setVariable` with `op`: `set` (default), `toggle`, `add` (a number adds; a list appends; a map merges),
`subtract`, `insert` / `removeAt` / `update` at `index`, `remove`. `value` is an expression. A chain that branches:
`if` with a `condition` (a predicate: `{"left": "${count}", "op": "greaterThan", "right": "5"}`, `{"left":
"${name}", "op": "isEmpty"}`; every op is in [Conditions](#state-conditions)) and `then` / `else` chains. Every
action also takes `when`, the same kind of predicate object (run only while it holds); a trigger's `when` is a
formula string instead (`"when": "!item.future"`). `forEach` runs a chain per item; `delay` waits.

```json
{"type": "if", "condition": {"left": "${= contains(saved, trip.id)}", "op": "isTrue"},
 "then": [{"type": "setVariable", "variable": "saved", "op": "remove", "value": "${trip.id}"}],
 "else": [{"type": "setVariable", "variable": "saved", "op": "add", "value": "${trip.id}"}]}
```

One line of a list, from its own row of a list template (a cart's quantity stepper): `update` at the row's `index`
with the row's record changed. `value` is one expression giving the new record (`set` changes one field), not an
object written out:

```json
{"type": "setVariable", "variable": "cart", "op": "update", "index": "${index}", "value": "${= set(item, 'qty', item.qty + 1)}"}
```

The condition is an object, never a formula string: a formula goes in `left` with `"op": "isTrue"`.

<a id="state-setting-several-nodes-with-a-condition"></a>
### Setting several nodes with a condition

A condition sets node fields while a test holds: an ordered list of branches (if, else if, ..., else) under a canvas
id in the document's `conditions`. For one field the first branch that holds and sets it wins; a condition wins
over the node's binding. A binding with a formula is often simpler; conditions suit setting several nodes at once.

```json
{
  "schema": 3,
  "roots": ["plans"],
  "nodes": {
    "plans": {
      "type": "canvas",
      "slots": {"body": "col"},
      "layout": {"width": 390, "height": 300},
      "decoration": {"fills": [{"color": "#FFFFFFFF"}]}
    },
    "col": {
      "type": "column",
      "children": ["toggle", "price", "note"],
      "layout": {"width": {"fill": 390}, "height": {"fill": 300}, "padding": 24},
      "props": {"spacing": 12, "crossAxisAlignment": "start"}
    },
    "toggle": {
      "type": "row",
      "children": ["toggleLabel"],
      "layout": {"width": {"hug": 120}, "height": {"hug": 36}, "padding": [14, 8, 14, 8]},
      "decoration": {"strokes": [{"color": "#FF2563EB"}], "radius": 18},
      "actions": [
        {
          "trigger": {"type": "click"},
          "actions": [{"type": "setVariable", "variable": "annual", "op": "toggle"}]
        }
      ]
    },
    "toggleLabel": {
      "type": "text",
      "layout": {"width": {"hug": 80}, "height": {"hug": 20}},
      "props": {"text": "Monthly", "style": {"fontSize": 14, "color": "#FF2563EB"}},
      "bind": {"props.text": "${= annual ? 'Annual billing' : 'Monthly billing'}"}
    },
    "price": {
      "type": "text",
      "layout": {"width": {"hug": 80}, "height": {"hug": 40}},
      "props": {"text": "$12 / month", "style": {"fontSize": 32, "fontWeight": 700, "color": "#FF111827"}}
    },
    "note": {
      "type": "text",
      "layout": {"width": {"hug": 80}, "height": {"hug": 20}},
      "props": {"text": "Save 20% with annual billing", "style": {"fontSize": 14, "color": "#FF16A34A"}}
    }
  },
  "variables": {"plans": [{"name": "annual", "type": "boolean", "value": false}]},
  "conditions": {
    "plans": [
      {
        "id": "billing",
        "branches": [
          {
            "when": {"left": "${annual}", "op": "isTrue"},
            "set": [
              {"node": "price", "path": "props.text", "value": "$120 / year"},
              {"node": "note", "path": "visible", "value": false}
            ]
          },
          {"set": [{"node": "price", "path": "props.text", "value": "$12 / month"}]}
        ]
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

<a id="state-when-to-use-a-script"></a>
### When to use a script

For multi-step state changes (a puzzle's checks, a game step, a streak over dates), a script reads and sets
variables with `vars.get(name)` and `vars.set(name, value)` (capabilities `variables.read`, `variables.write`);
the UI updates through what binds to them. A script cannot draw or touch nodes. A reaction runs it (`{"type":
"runScript", "script": "place", "arguments": {"cell": "${index}"}}`); a formula calls a pure one
(`${= script.isSolved(board)}`).

<a id="state-pitfalls"></a>
## Pitfalls

- `${false}` reads a variable called `false`: a literal is `${= false}`.
- Values in `props`, `layout` and `decoration` are literal: `"opacity": "${x}"` is an error; bind it.
- A backslash in a formula is written twice in JSON: `"${= matches(code, '^\\d{4}$')}"`.
- A component never reads its caller's variables: pass them as parameters.
- Per-breakpoint canvases have separate variables: shared state lives in `page_variables`.
- A function variable named like a formula function is never called (the built-in wins).
- Formula syntax errors and unknown names in formulas are reported by the render command (the SDK parses them).
- A misspelled binding path is `unknown_bind_path`; a name nothing declares is `unknown_name`.
